baseline_characterization.qualification_role: descriptive; shared baseline speed is not a disqualifier

protocol.claim_boundary: physical perturbation calibration only; not balance, neural stabilization, reflexes, gait, biological function, MaleCNS, or M9B

fixed_actuation.commands: frozen corrected M7D/B4 baseline copied at every transition

matched_pair.comparison: timestamp-aligned P minus C; never own-pre-state displacement

perturbation.ladder_rationale: factor-two geometric escalation above 0.128; under local proportional extrapolation, its 0.000411825-mm maximum P-vs-0.0001 position signal predicts approximately 0.000824, 0.001647, 0.003295, and 0.006589 mm; outcomes cannot alter the ladder

physical_initialization.baseline_targets: exact measured corrected tripod joint state at time zero

selection_rule_preregistered.choice: lowest qualifying magnitude in frozen order; fail closed if none
selection_rule_preregistered.return_rationale: the future causal question is whether enabled neural feedback changes recovery; requiring >=25% passive return would select on an irrelevant property and can exclude a safe useful disturbance
